undischargedHonestyJudgment.question: Nine properties NOT DISCHARGED/PARTIAL + PROBE REOPENED — honesty or defeatism?
undischargedHonestyJudgment.answer: HONESTY. The alternative was paper seals (caught multiple times: C-2 v2 effectful DISCHARGED, completeness instrument inflation). Marking runtime authority, support windows, platform matrix, and product-implements-architecture as undischarged is the only non-corrupt posture when the substrate or measurement does not exist.
undischargedHonestyJudgment.risk: Consumer B may misread 11/11 contract-complete as build-complete. Completeness measures the *stated* criterion (invariants+schema+goldens+checker+no open findings), not discharge of every sealed property and not independent review. That is not instrument inflation of its own metric; it is a dangerous adjacent reading.
